title: 蛇梯棋
summary: 在蛇形编号棋盘上从一号格出发，每次掷一到六并立即按蛇或梯跳转，求到达 n² 格最少步数，不可达返回负一。
insight: 每个编号是图节点，六种骰子结果是边；把编号映射到从底向上交替方向的矩阵坐标，BFS 首次到终点最短。
pitfalls: 一回合最多只沿一条蛇或梯跳一次

solutions.title: 编号空间广度优先搜索
solutions.idea: 按骰子边扩展并解析蛇梯目的地。
steps: 映射 next 到 board 坐标，若格值非 -1 则 destination=格值，否则 next；未访问入队，命中终点返回 distance+1

code.java: class Solution { public int snakesAndLadders(int[][] board){int n=board.length,target=n*n;Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();boolean[] seen=new boolean[target+1];queue.offer(new int[]{1,0});seen[1]=true;while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] state=queue.poll();if(state[0]==target)return state[1];for(int next=state[0]+1;next<=Math.min(target,state[0]+6);next++){int quotient=(next-1)/n,row=n-1-quotient,column=(next-1)%n;if(quotient%2==1)column=n-1-column;int destination=board[row][column]==-1?next:board[row][column];if(!seen[destination]){seen[destination]=true;queue.offer(new int[]{destination,state[1]+1});}}}return -1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun snakesAndLadders(board:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=board.size;val target=n*n;val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();val seen=BooleanArray(target+1);queue.addLast(intArrayOf(1,0));seen[1]=true;while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.removeFirst();if(state[0]==target)return state[1];for(next in state[0]+1..minOf(target,state[0]+6)){val quotient=(next-1)/n;val row=n-1-quotient;var column=(next-1)%n;if(quotient%2==1)column=n-1-column;val destination=if(board[row][column]==-1)next else board[row][column];if(!seen[destination]){seen[destination]=true;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(destination,state[1]+1))}}};return -1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int snakesAndLadders(vector<vector<int>>& board){int n=board.size(),target=n*n;queue<pair<int,int>> pending;vector<bool> seen(target+1);pending.push({1,0});seen[1]=true;while(!pending.empty()){auto [label,distance]=pending.front();pending.pop();if(label==target)return distance;for(int next=label+1;next<=min(target,label+6);++next){int quotient=(next-1)/n,row=n-1-quotient,column=(next-1)%n;if(quotient%2)column=n-1-column;int destination=board[row][column]==-1?next:board[row][column];if(!seen[destination]){seen[destination]=true;pending.push({destination,distance+1});}}}return -1;} };
